(1) social studies teachers do not have a shared understanding of democracy and (2) the lack of a shared understanding of the concept is related to the lack of a clear definition of social studies.
the majority of the respondents (1) do not have a clear idea of what democracy is, and (2) do not see the importance of democracy for the social studies.

(1) there is a positive relationship between democratic and pluralistic values, (2) the relationship is stronger when the values of democracy are more highly regarded, and (3) there are no differences in the relationship between the two value systems across gender, age, or political party identification.

we have been exploring the ways in which democracy and pluralism can inform the social studies.
